neighbours.label: the modifier noun just before the head of a fixed compound term (income [tax], antibody [test], submission [fee], Courts [Act])
fire: Most workers pay income tax on their wages every month.
The lab ran an antibody test on the blood sample.
There is a one-time application submission fee of $30.
No action under the Contempt of Courts Act was taken.
The city collects a property tax from every homeowner.
Students took a phoneme segmentation test in the autumn.
The factory must follow the pollution control law strictly.
Applicants must pay a visa processing fee at the embassy.
quiet: Most workers earn a modest income from their wages every month.
The lab found antibodies in the blood sample.
Every application needs a careful submission before May.
The judge said the courts would not take any action.
The city sold the property to a new homeowner.
Students learned to split words into phonemes in the autumn.
The factory tries to keep pollution low in the river.
Applicants wait for weeks while the embassy processes visas.

notes: card only; top examples peak on the noun before the head of an institutional/technical compound
